subject: Intake: Accreditation & Exhibit ownership for MSA + Order Form
messages:
From: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@accreditix.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Sep 2025 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: MSA + Order Form — Party accreditation & exhibit list

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the intro — attaching our party statement and a short SOC2 summary to help with the intake. We completed an internal review of the Redwood template and have a few high-level asks around the Exhibit B residency language and the signatory matrix. I attached: Acct-Party-Statement.pdf (contains our corporate addresses and three signers), and Accreditix-SOC2-summary.pdf.

Quick context: Accreditix is executing this as a US entity (Accreditix, Inc.). We anticipate a single billing entity but two operational affiliates that will need Exhibit ownership called out.

Questions for you to capture in intake:
- Can Redwood list the two affiliates as Exhibit Owners (they will not be named on the Order Form but must be referenced for data residency)?
- Will the standard residency Exhibit B be sufficient or do you need granular region-by-region residency language?
- Who should be the signatory on the Order Form if we sign at the Accreditix, Inc. entity level but designate an affiliate as primary operational contact?

I looped Marissa since she handles onboarding logistics on your side. Happy to hop on a quick call if it's easier.

Attachments: Acct-Party-Statement.pdf (pdf), Accreditix-SOC2-summary.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Patricia Gomez
Head of Legal Ops
Accreditix

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@accreditix.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Sep 2025 17:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form — Party accreditation & exhibit list

Patricia — thanks for the docs, helpful. A few intake notes and asks from our side to make the contracting workflow smooth: 

1) Exhibit ownership: we can reference the two operational affiliates in Exhibit B as Owners. To avoid having to add them as contractual parties on the MSA, please confirm the exact legal names and country of incorporation for both affiliates (we need these for the clause and for our compliance intake).

2) Residency granularity: For now, the standard Exhibit B text is usually sufficient for most customers. If you require region-by-region commitments (e.g., EU data residency guarantees), flag that explicitly — that will move this into a cross-functional review (security + product) and may change timelines.

3) Signatory flow: If Accreditix, Inc. signs the Order Form but designates Affiliate A as the operational contact, we typically put that designation in the Order Form's "Operational Owner" field and retain Accreditix, Inc. as the signee. We still need a billing contact and an invoicing address from you.

Action items for Accreditix (can you confirm these in a reply):
- Legal names + incorporation jurisdictions for Affiliate A and Affiliate B
- Billing entity and billing contact (name, email, billing address)
- Preferred signatory name and title for Accreditix, Inc.

Marissa — can you pick up the intake checklist below and confirm the internal owners for evidence collection (SOC2 artifact request, KYC, signed attestation)? David — FYI on residency question in case product/security needs to triage.

Thanks — if you want a short 20m sync tomorrow I can set it up.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships (Contracts intake)
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@accreditix.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 09:48:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form — Party accreditation & exhibit list

Patricia — thanks for sending this over. A couple notes from Legal to help speed the redline pass: 

- Timeline: we aim to do an initial redline within 3 business days of receiving the affiliate legal names + billing contact + any residency exceptions. If there are residency commitments beyond standard Exhibit B we will need Security/Product input and that will add ~5–7 business days.

- Missing items we need to attach/verify:
  * W-9 / tax ID for billing entity (US customers) or VAT registration for EU entities
  * Full legal names and incorporation jurisdictions for both affiliates
  * A point person for KYC (email + phone) so our compliance team can request SOC2 artifacts if needed

- Signatory guidance: if Accreditix prefers Accreditix, Inc. as signee but wants Affiliate A operationally listed, we will add an "Operational Owner" line in the Order Form and retain the MSA signature block to Accreditix, Inc. If you want the affiliate to be a contracting party, please state that explicitly — that triggers multi-party MSA work and redlines the signature block.

I pasted Markus' ask below and added bold markers for the required intake fields.

> Action items for Accreditix (please reply inline):
> - LEGAL NAME + JURISDICTION (Affiliate A)
> - LEGAL NAME + JURISDICTION (Affiliate B)
> - BILLING ENTITY NAME, BILLING EMAIL, BILLING ADDRESS
> - PREFERRED SIGNATORY NAME & TITLE
> - KYC CONTACT (name, email, phone)

Attachments: none from legal side yet.

If you reply with the items above I will start the redline; otherwise we can take the standard template and mark the Exhibit references as "TBD affiliates" until we have those details.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
